facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 59°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 12 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Stampede Pass
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: May 30 (2023), June 2 (2024), May 29 (2025)

evidence.name: Meadows Pass
evidence.detail: left May 3; earlier seasons: May 24 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 5 (2025)

evidence.name: Tinkham Creek
evidence.detail: left May 2; earlier seasons: May 30 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 12 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Stampede Pass
evidence.detail: 15.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 36.2 in (2023), 23.5 in (2024), 24.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Meadows Pass
evidence.detail: 13.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 30.6 in (2023), 20.6 in (2024), 18.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Tinkham Creek
evidence.detail: 11.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 30.2 in (2023), 15.6 in (2024), 17.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 16 and June 5, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Stampede Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 179 ft above the pass; points to April 12 to May 28

evidence.name: Meadows Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 3, 441 ft below the pass; points to April 16 to June 5

evidence.name: Tinkham Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 2, 671 ft below the pass; points to April 17 to June 9
